senses.definition: n.pr.m. Hρ (cf. עוּר Qal Pt.);—
eldest son of Judah Gn 38:3, 6 = 1 Ch 2:3(×2), Gn 38:7; 46:12(×2) Nu 26:19(×2).
son of Judah’s son Shelah 1 Ch 4:21.—Vid. also Qal Pt. עֵר supr.
